name: video-shot-refinement
purpose: Repair a bounded visual interval after main video generation by combining one identity image, one target-person scene and lighting image, and one grayscale depth action video, then cutting the accepted patch back into the locked master.
output_contract: The main video-replication workflow remains the source of truth.
Each run repairs one continuous interval.
The Seedance request binds identity, scene and lighting, and depth motion as distinct reference roles.
Audible intervals bind reference audio and generate audio; proven-silent visual patches preserve the master audio during deterministic local replacement.
Multi-shot repairs bind a source-verified motion blueprint with exact shot count, hard cuts, trajectories, peaks, and end states.
Motion and expression remain separate evidence chains and must both pass.
Accepted regions outside the replacement interval remain locked.
